narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a comedic vlog documenting a wedding anniversary prank. Initially, the female creator details a plan to test her husband's reaction to 'attractive' strangers. However, the narrative shifts to show the husband discovering the prank in real-time through his home security system, turning the joke back on the prankster.
